Evidence: The Tokyo 2020 Olympic and Paralympic Games were postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic, with the decision made by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and the Tokyo Organising Committee (TOCOG) to safeguard health. The Games were originally scheduled for July 24 to August 9, 2020, but were moved to summer 2021, while still being referred to as the 2020 Tokyo Olympics (Source 1, Source 2). The postponement was necessary to allow for better understanding of the pandemic and to manage the health services in Japan (Source 2).
Justification: The retrieved evidence clearly states that the Tokyo Olympics were postponed to summer 2021, not 2022, contradicting the claim that they would be held in 2022. The decision was made to ensure the health and safety of all involved, as outlined in the evidence from Sources 1 and 2.
